critical_code_review_comments: admin_reauth is 5/300s per admin — the r29 attest proof flow consumes 5 reauth slots in one test (stale, ecn no-override, ecn short-reason, ecn override good, good demo), so running test_r29_http.py twice inside the 5-min window will hit 429 on the vault_rewrap test too. The new suite handles this gracefully (per-step 429 → skip for the attest test; test_admin_vault_rewrap self-skips on 429). Consider resetting the counter on successful reauth OR raising the limit to 10/300s so a full admin audit cycle fits in one run.

demo_proof check order inside admin_attest_account_environment: _reauth runs BEFORE the proof/declared validation, so an admin who mistypes a reason or omits proof still burns a reauth slot. Running the cheap input/proof validation first (and reauthing only when we're about to persist) would make the rate-limit far less fragile in testing/ops.
